messages.subject: For François Provost | Mobility transformation, government relations and strategic partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Chaix,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. François Provost, Chief Executive Officer.

Renault Group's next strategic phase across electrification, technology, partnerships and international growth requires disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, communities and operating teams. That interface closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support Renault Group's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Renault Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
